name: 02642 · Eastham, MA
findings: ZIP 02642 (Eastham) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02642 (Eastham) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02642 (Eastham) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
